translations.text: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.
Consider your calling, my brothers: not many of you are wise by human standards, not many of you are powerful, and not many of you come from noble families.
As it is written: Whoever boasts should boast in the Lord.
None of the rulers of this world knew it, for if they had known it, they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.
For who has known the mind of the Lord so that he might teach him? But we have the mind of Christ.
So neither the one who plants nor the one who waters is anything, but God is the one who makes things grow.
For we work with God, and you are God's cultivated field and God's building.
According to the grace of God given to me, I laid a foundation like a wise master builder, and another person is building on it. But each person should take care how he builds on it.
Do you not know that you are God's temple and that God's Spirit lives in you?
Therefore, do not judge before the time, until the Lord comes. He brings to light the things hidden in darkness and reveals the thoughts of hearts. Then each person will receive praise from God.
Nor will greedy people, thieves, drunkards, those who insult others, or robbers inherit the kingdom of God.
Or do you not know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who lives in you, whom you received from God, and that you do not belong to yourselves?
For you were bought at a price. Therefore, glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which belong to God.
Now concerning the things you wrote to me about: it is good for a man not to have sexual relations with a woman.
But take care that this freedom of yours does not become a stumbling block to the weak.
Everyone who competes exercises self-control in everything. They run to receive a crown that perishes, but we run to receive one that does not perish.
But God was not pleased with most of them, for they fell in the wilderness.
Everything is permitted to me, but not everything is beneficial. Everything is permitted to me, but not everything builds up.
No one should seek his own good alone, but everyone should also seek the good of his neighbor.
For if a woman does not cover herself, let her also have her hair cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or shaved, let her cover herself.
In giving you this instruction, I am not praising you, because you have not moved forward but have declined.
There are different kinds of service, but the Lord is one.
For just as the body is one and has many parts, and all the parts of the body, though many, are one body, so also is Christ.
Now you are Christ's body, and each of you is a part in your own place.
So also you, since you are eager for the gifts of the Spirit, should seek to excel in building up the church.
For you offer a blessing well, but your companion is not built up.
For God is not a God of disorder but of peace, as in all the churches of the saints.
I swear, my brothers, by the pride I have in you in our Lord Jesus Christ, that I die every day.
But not all bodies are alike. The human body is one kind, the body of an animal another, the body of a bird another, and the body of a fish another.
There are heavenly bodies, and there are earthly bodies. But the glory of the heavenly bodies is one kind, and that of the earthly bodies is another.
Therefore, my brothers and loved ones, be firm and do not be shaken. Instead, always excel in the work of the Lord, knowing that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
For I do not want to see you now merely while passing through. I hope to stay with you for some time, if my Lord permits me.
As for Apollos, my brothers, I urged him strongly to come to you with the brothers. But apparently he was not willing to come to you. When he has an opportunity, he will come to you.
